facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet on a black background, arranged in three rows: a large cinematic hero shot on top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle, and four close-up detail panels along the bottom.

The top hero panel shows a single standing man centered on a wet, rain-slicked paved walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides and blurred city lights and warm glowing lamps in the background; rain streaks are visible in the air.
The man has a shaved-sided undercut with the longer dark hair gathered into a small top knot at the back of his head; he appears of East Asian descent with a lean, athletic build.

He wears an all-black tactical outfit: a dark collared jacket with shoulder straps and hardware over a plain dark crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers with multiple pockets, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero shot his body faces slightly toward the viewer while his head is turned to his right, gaze directed off-frame; his arms hang relaxed at his sides.
The middle row contains three full-body studio-style views against a plain dark grey backdrop, labeled from left to right: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK.

In the FRONT panel the man stands squarely facing the camera with arms at his sides and a neutral expression; in SIDE PROFILE he faces left in a side-on stance showing the top knot; in BACK he faces away, showing the jacket's rear seams and collar.
The bottom row contains four detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE panel is a tight close-up showing short shaved sides, a faint scar or mark on the right eyebrow area, and a serious, level gaze at the camera.

The JACKET COLLAR panel shows a close crop of black fabric with a metal buckle and strap detail; the HANDS panel shows two weathered hands with visible veins resting one over the other; the BOOTS panel shows a close crop of worn black leather lace-up boots with thick soles.

Lighting is dark and moody overall: the hero shot uses cool blue-grey night light with warm amber accents from distant lamps and reflective wet ground, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft low-key directional studio light against a near-black backdrop.
The palette is dominated by black and charcoal tones, with muted grey skin tones, cool desaturated blue-greys in the hero location, and small warm amber highlights.

limitations: Panel labels are the only legible text; no other writing, signage, or insignia is readable.
The identity of the person and the specific fictional setting are not stated in the image and cannot be confirmed.
Fine surface details in the darker panels (e.g., exact strap configuration, boot tread) are partly lost in shadow.

card.summary: A dark, cinematic character reference sheet for a lone male figure in black tactical clothing: a rainy nighttime hero shot on a bridge-like walkway, three full-body turnaround views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK, and four detail close-ups labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.
